article.title: Person arrested to be taken before Magistrate or officer in charge of police station
article.content: A police officer making an arrest without warrant shall, without unnecessary delay and subject to the provisions herein contained as to bail, take or send the person arrested before a Magistrate having jurisdiction in the case, or before the officer in charge of a police station.
article.html:
57Person arrested to be taken before Magistrate or officer in charge of police station

Section 57 · Chapter V

A police officer making an arrest without warrant shall, without unnecessary delay and subject to the provisions herein contained as to bail, take or send the person arrested before a Magistrate having jurisdiction in the case, or before the officer in charge of a police station.
